name: n2rad51_additions_spot_truth_decisions
description: The spot-truth decisions of protocol changelog entries 10 (c) and 11 for the additions of entry 9 (tests/golden/rad51_additions.json), read by scripts/benchmark_manifest.py --spot-truth-decisions (germquant.validate.benchmark_split.addition_spot_truth_usable). Entry 10 applied the criteria entry 9 (d)(5) and (e) declared before the results, with the section 4.4 criterion read as a minimum of 99.35 percent (entry 10 (b)). Entry 11 replaces the decision on n2rad51_20260105a_HS_male_001 by the project lead's answer to the post hoc like-for-like reading of entry 10 (b) and (c) ('10 sure'); its entry-10 decision is kept under 'replaces'. A decision cannot make usable a gonad whose frame check failed or whose xlsx export failed a criterion other than V7. Roles do not change: all four stay train gonads, and a gonad without spot truth keeps its nucleus truth. A later changelog entry may replace a decision; it then names itself in 'entry'.

n2rad51_20260105a_HS_male_001.reason: post hoc under rule 3 (entry 11): the project lead kept its spot truth under the like-for-like reading of entry 10 (b), '10 sure' to the question that put it to him; section 4.4 agreement 0.9807 (5087 of 5187 spots), and 0.9990 (5087 of 5092) with the 95 spots whose mask-channel value is no kept truth label (nuclei present in Masked 405 but deleted from the Surfaces after masking) taken out of the count and the total, inside the 0.9974 to 1.0000 of the registered train and val gonads read the same way; no truth-export bug found

replaces.reason: section 4.4 agreement 0.9807 (5087 of 5187 spots), below the minimum 0.9935 of entry 9 (d)(5); no truth-export bug found (95 spots carry the fill value of nuclei present in Masked 405 but deleted from the Surfaces); spot truth removed as entry 9 (d)(5) declares, nucleus truth kept; the post hoc reading that would keep it is put to the project lead (entry 10 (c))

n2rad51_20260105a_HS_male_002.reason: section 4.4 agreement 0.9960 (11980 of 12028 spots), at least the minimum 0.9935 of entry 9 (d)(5); frame check passed with the rounded voxel (entry 9 (d)(3)); spot truth kept

n2rad51_20260105a_HS_male_003.reason: section 4.4 agreement 0.9847 (6363 of 6462 spots), below the minimum 0.9935 of entry 9 (d)(5), and 0.9969 like for like, below the registered 0.9974, with 2 spots assigned to two different nuclei; no truth-export bug found; spot truth removed as entry 9 (d)(5) declares, nucleus truth kept; the post hoc reading is put to the project lead (entry 10 (c))
